messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 Alert - runtime/paged-kv: sustained OOM spike on us-west-2-gpu-pool. 30% error rate on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Auto-scale failed to reclaim.

maria: I'm on it. seeing repeated process restarts for container redwood-runtime-embeddings on gpu-12. logs show CUBLAS_ALLOC_FAILED and then kernel crash.

adan: grabbing allocator stats now — KV cache shows resident pages stable but free page fragmentation creeping up to 78%. `page_bitmap` has long runs of non-contiguous frees.

kevin: customer-facing impact — support queue: multiple customers reporting 5xx and 2-10s spikes on embedding requests. priority accounts hit intermittently.

jen: likely paged-attn allocator fragmentation + slow leak. quick mitigation: quarantine node, force drain that pod, enable aggressive evictions for the pool. I'll run cordon/drain and bump eviction factor.

jen: commands I'm going to run:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-12
kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --timeout=5m
redwoodctl node set-evict --node gpu-12 --factor 3 --immediate
```

deploy-bot: executed redwoodctl node set-evict --node gpu-12 --factor 3 --immediate (by jen) — queued to control plane.

maria: cordon+drain issued. pods are terminating, some kept restarting on same node due to kube-proxy sticky scheduling; forcing kill on stuck containers.

ops-bot: ran remote command on gpu-12: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kv-scan --compact --force --max-threads 4` (started). progress logs: compaction pass 1/3, reclaimed 12MB so far.

adan: compaction helps reduce fragmentation but slow — reclaimed chunks are small. After compaction free runs improved to ~60% contiguous but there are still slabs with zeroed refs. suspect CUDA allocation handles retained in driver after crash.

lia: routing note — I'm creating a canary rule to route 25% of embed/generate traffic to fallback-quantized model pool (lower residency). That should cut pressure. creating rule now.

kevin: notify support: sent customer update with ETA ~2h for full remediation, suggested workarounds (retry/backoff) to affected customers. ticket IDs attached.

maria: after drain, restarted the container on replacement host gpu-17. memory curves look better there. gpu-12 still slowly climbing even while offline — looks like node-local kernel driver state is leaking (observed repeated leaked CUDA contexts in dmesg).

jen: plan for next steps: 1) keep node cordoned, 2) full host reboot of gpu-12 (host-level driver reset), 3) run extended compaction + slab scavenger, 4) push hotfix to allocator that triggers async scavenger sooner. if reboot clears driver handles we can repro less often.

adan: agreed. I captured heaptrace and KV allocator map. attaching excerpt:
```
Allocator snapshot: total_pages=524k, used=411k, free_runs=32k, avg_run_len=2.1, frag_index=0.78
Top consumers: embeddings-worker (x3), chat-compat (x1)
Recent errors: CUBLAS_ALLOC_FAILED @ 0x7f8c2b.., driver oom - leaked handle count +7 post-crash
```

lia: canary routing is live. we see 18% drop in page fault rate within first 2 minutes for routed traffic. good sign.

jen: I'll draft a short hotfix to add an emergency 'evict-ramp' flag that temporarily reduces KV residency per-request. target to ship to prod tomorrow AM after QA.

maria: monitoring: error-rate dropping from 30% -> 5% after routing + node quarantine + compaction. still some residual 500s from older requests hitting sticky backend. continuing to monitor.

kevin: ops note — customers on dedicated plans: opened escalation, offering temporary routing and capacity shift to dedicated pool.

adan: long-term: add a periodic defrag sweep and an allocator scavenger thread; add telemetry on CUDA handle counts per process. will file RFC.

maria: temporary status: mitigated -> monitoring. keeping this thread open for 2h. if we see repeat OOMs we'll promote global fallback and escalate to infra. @jen @adan please follow up on hotfix/RFC. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident updated to MONITORING by maria. final metrics snapshot: 5xx rate 4.7%, latency p95 for embeddings 850ms (baseline 120ms).

jen: I'll schedule the host reboot window for gpu-12 in 30m once compaction finishes. post-reboot we'll run extended compaction and then uncordon only if driver leak doesn't reappear.

maria: thanks team — oncall will hand off in 2h but keeping watch. I'll update post-mortem once root cause confirmed.

deploy-bot: note: rolling hotfix branch created: `hotfix/kv-async-scavenger`. PR opened, CI green, awaiting review.

kevin: closing customer-facing note for now. continue internal tracking.

maria: closing thread for now, switching to watch mode. :mag:
